answer.reason: The verses tell of Abram settling and building an altar there, the LORD appearing there, and Sarah being buried in the cave before it.

clauses.english: was where Abram dwelt and built an altar to the LORD
clauses.quote: built there an altar unto the LORD

clauses.english: was where the LORD appeared to Abraham
clauses.quote: the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre

clauses.english: was beside the cave where Abraham buried Sarah
clauses.quote: buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre

doubts: GEN 14:13 names Mamre the Amorite, a man and ally of Abram, so it was left out as concerning someone else of the same name.
Other burials before Mamre (Abraham, Isaac, Jacob) were not made separate clauses.
